_comment: Copy to the server (e.g. D:\ZedV4\settings.json), fill in, restrict to administrators. Never commit the filled copy. Keys are environment variable names: ':' becomes '__'. Sections are merged in order: 'Common' (every application), then 'Portals' (main, Consultancy, Surveillance) or 'Mobile' (the three mobile deployments), then the application's own section, which wins. Install-ZedIis.ps1 adds ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production, DataProtection__KeysPath (per application) and Mobile__System itself. Each host refuses to start and lists what is missing (docs/CUTOVER.md).

Main._comment: IIS application /. Consultancy and Surveillance connections: a read-only login (EXECUTE on the report procedures).

Consultancy._comment: IIS application /Consultancy. StorageRoot: the same folder as main's.

Surveillance._comment: IIS application /surveillance. StorageRoot: the same folder as main's.

MobileMain._comment: IIS application /mobileapi. StorageRoot: the old services site's folder (Photos, SaPhotos, Videos). Culture: what the old server used (docs/MOBILE-API.md).
